Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِـهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَتَوَلَّنِيْ فِيْ جِيرَانِيْ وَمَوَالِيَّ الْعَارِفِينَ بِحَقِّنَا وَالْمُنَابِذِيْنَ لِأَعْدَائِنَا بِأَفْضَلِ وَلَايَتِكَ
Translation: And take me as guardian in the matter of my neighbors and my friends who recognize our rights and abandon our enemies with Your best guardianship
And give them success in establishing Your traditions

Arabic text: وَالْأَخْذِ بِمَحَاسِنِ أَدَبِكَ فِيْ إِرْفَاقِ ضَعِيفِهِمْ
Translation: And in adopting the most beautiful of Your manners in being kind to their weak ones
And filling their gaps, and visiting their sick
And guiding those who seek guidance, and giving sincere advice to those who consult them
And caring for their newcomers, and keeping their secrets
And covering their faults, and helping their oppressed ones
And supporting them well with aid
And returning to them with wealth and favor

Arabic text: وَإِعْطَاءِ مَا يَجِبُ لَهُمْ قَبْلَ السُّؤَالِ
Translation: And giving them what they deserve before they ask
And make me, O Allah, repay their evildoers with goodness
And turn away from their wrongdoers with forgiveness

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَعْمِلُ حُسْنَ الظَّنِّ فِيْ كَافَّتِهِمْ، وَأَتَوَلَّى بِالْبِرِّ عَامَّتَهُمْ
Translation: And have good thoughts about all of them, and be good to all of them
And lower my gaze from them out of chastity
And be gentle with them out of humility

Arabic text: وَأَرِقُّ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَلَاءِ مِنْهُمْ رَحْمَةً
Translation: And be compassionate to those of them who are in distress out of mercy
And have affection for them in their absence
And wish for the continuance of blessings for them sincerely
And make obligatory for them what I make obligatory for my close ones
And observe for them what I observe for my special ones

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family
And provide me with the same from them

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ أَوْفَى الْحُظُوظِ فِيمَا عِنْدَهُمْ
Translation: And grant me the fullest share of what they have

Arabic text: وَزِدْهُمْ بَصِيرَةً فِيْ حَقِّي، وَمَعْرِفَةً بِفَضْلِي
Translation: And increase their insight into my rights and their recognition of my excellence
So that they may be happy with me and I may be happy with them
Amen, O Lord of the worlds
